response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates extensive fullstack development experience with a strong emphasis on TypeScript, React, and Node.js, aligning well with the required skills. His background in scalable architectures, cloud services (AWS), and Kubernetes (via GISCollective) exceeds the junior/mid-level requirements. While his experience leans toward senior roles, his adaptability and depth of technical knowledge suggest he could thrive in this position, provided he demonstrates willingness to engage in hands-on implementation rather than strategic oversight.
strengths: Extensive fullstack experience with TypeScript, React, and Node.js
Proven track record in scalable architectures, cloud services (AWS), and Kubernetes
Strong problem-solving skills and adaptability across diverse tech stacks
concerns: Over-qualified for junior/mid-level role, may seek higher responsibility
Limited direct experience with PostgreSQL (uses MySQL/MongoDB)
High on-site presence requirement may conflict with current remote-focused roles
